seo_title: Low Miles, High Miles & Third-Party Lease Buyouts: Listener Q&A
keywords: can I buy my lease through another lender
takeaways: Low miles can mean your car is worth more than its buyout price, and most leases don't pay you back for unused miles.
Over your miles? Buying usually avoids the mileage charge, but compare the payoff with what the car is worth first.
Whether you can buy directly or use your own lender depends on the leasing company, so ask them, not the dealer.
Buying usually means sales tax on the purchase, and rules vary by state.
